meta_title: Artosia: free worship presentation software for Windows
meta_description: Artosia puts song words, Bible verses and announcements on a church's projector. Free for Windows, in English and Indonesian.
hero_lead: Artosia is free software that puts songs, Bible verses and announcements on a church's projector, from the Windows PC at the media desk.
stage_caption: Press Next. The red row is what the room sees.
stage_alt_0: The Artosia window: the plan on the left, the next song in the middle, and on the right the slide on the projector, marked red
stage_alt_1: The same window one slide later
stage_alt_2: The same window two slides later
stage_alt_3: The same window three slides later
wall_title: The room sees only the words
wall_text: The projector runs as its own program, so the words stay up even if the operator window stops.
wall_alt: Four lines of a song in white on a dark blue screen
search_title: Find a song by any line
search_text: Type the title or whatever line you remember. Typos are forgiven, and the matching words are marked.
search_caption: Search opens when you start typing
search_alt: The search box with two words typed and four songs found, the matching words in blue
look_text: Six looks are ready. Behind the words goes a colour, a picture, a looping video or a camera, with 318 free backdrops to choose from.
look_alt: The Design dialog with six ready looks and a preview of the words
screens_title: Straighten the picture from the desk
screens_text: A second screen is found and filled by itself. Move its four corners until the picture on the wall is square.
screens_alt: The Screens dialog with two screens listed and four corners to move
notices_text: Slides that loop while people arrive, typed in or brought in from a PowerPoint file or a birthday list.
notices_alt: The announcements editor with a list of slides and a birthdays slide in the projector preview
step_download_text: A small setup file of {size} MB.
step_open_text: Windows may warn about an unknown publisher the first time, because the programs are not code-signed.
step_ready_text: The setup fetches the program, adds it to the desktop and the Start menu, and opens it. This needs the internet.
zip_note: For a computer with no internet there is a zip of {zipsize} MB to unzip into a folder of your own.
fact_runs_text: Windows 10 and 11, 64-bit, and tried on Windows 11 so far. Mac and Linux are planned and untested.
fact_needs_text: A projector or a second screen. One screen is enough to try it.
fact_bible_text: Verses by reference, such as John 3:16-18, from the Bibles you add.
fact_library_text: Reads EasiSlides and OpenLyrics song files.
fact_phone_text: A web page on the same Wi-Fi moves the slides.
fact_language_text: English and Indonesian, in the window and in the search.
fact_updates_text: Each copy fetches the newest release by itself and checks its signature.
fact_price_text: Free. The source is open under GPL-3.0-or-later.
